license_required.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person to practice or to offer to practice in this state, engineering or land surveying, as defined in the provisions of this chapter, or to use in connection with his or her name or otherwise assume, use, or advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that he or she is a professional engineer or a land surveyor, unless such a person has been duly registered under the provisions of this chapter.

moral_character_required.quote: No person shall be eligible for registration as a professional engineer, engineer-in-training, professional land surveyor, or land-surveyor-in-training, who is not of good character and reputation.

degree_required.value: Graduation in an approved engineering curriculum of four years or more from a school or college approved by the board as of satisfactory standing shall be considered equivalent to four years of such required experience.
degree_required.quote: Graduation in an approved engineering curriculum of four years or more from a school or college approved by the board as of satisfactory standing shall be considered equivalent to four years of such required experience.

degree_level.quote: Graduation in an approved engineering curriculum of four years or more from a school or college approved by the board as of satisfactory standing shall be considered equivalent to four years of such required experience.

credential_pegged.quote: Graduation in an approved engineering curriculum of four years or more from a school or college approved by the board as of satisfactory standing shall be considered equivalent to four years of such required experience.

required.quote: A specific record of eight years or more of experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board and indicating that the applicant is competent to practice engineering

exams.name: Fundamentals of Engineering (Engineer-in-Training examination)
exams.notes: First stage of the two-stage examination; may be taken upon achieving senior standing or after four years of experience.
exams.quote: The first stage of the examination shall test the applicant's knowledge of appropriate fundamentals of engineering subjects, including mathematics and the basic sciences.

exams.name: Principles and Practice of Engineering (Professional Engineer examination)
exams.notes: Second stage of the two-stage examination; taken after completing the required eight years of experience.
exams.jurisdiction: Board-administered (state); NCEES principles and practice exam referenced in RCW 18.43.100 for waiver purposes
exams.quote: At any time after the completion of the required eight years of engineering experience, as defined in this section, the applicant may take the second stage of the examination upon submission of an application for registration and payment of the application fee

interval_years.quote: Certificates of registration, and certificates of authorization and renewals thereof, shall expire on the last day of the month of December following their issuance or renewal and shall become invalid on that date unless renewed.

required.quote: Beginning July 1, 2007, the board may not renew a certificate of registration for a land surveyor unless the registrant verifies to the board that he or she has completed at least fifteen hours of continuing professional development per year of the registration period.

available.quote: The board may, upon application and the payment of a fee determined by the board, issue a certificate as a professional engineer or land surveyor to any person who holds a certificate of qualification of registration issued to the applicant following examination by proper authority, of any state or territory or possession of the United States, the District of Columbia, or of any foreign country

requirements.value: Applicant must meet all requirements of the chapter and board rules, be in good standing with the licensing agency in the other jurisdiction, and hold a certificate issued after examination by proper authority. The board shall waive the fundamentals examination for applicants who have passed the NCEES principles and practice examination and met experience and education requirements.
requirements.quote: The board shall waive the fundamentals examination for applicants who have passed the national council for examiners for engineering and surveying principles and practice examination, have met the experience and education requirements established by the board, and are in good standing with the licensing agency in a state, territory, possession, district, or foreign country.

exists.quote: A state board of registration for professional engineers and land surveyors is hereby created which shall exercise all of the powers and perform all of the duties conferred upon it by this chapter.

national_association.value: National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying (NCEES)
national_association.quote: By July 1, 2006, the board shall adopt rules governing continuing professional development for land surveyors that are generally patterned after the model rules of the national council of examiners for engineering and surveying.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, paying, or accepting any substantial gift, bribe, or other consideration to influence the award of professional work.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering to pay, paying or accepting, either directly or indirectly, any substantial gift, bribe, or other consideration to influence the award of professional work

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being willfully untruthful or deceptive in any professional report, statement or testimony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being willfully untruthful or deceptive in any professional report, statement or testimony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to injure falsely or maliciously the professional reputation, prospects, or business of anyone.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to injure falsely or maliciously, directly or indirectly, the professional reputation, prospects or business of anyone

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to state separately or charge separately for professional engineering services where other services are also performed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to state separately or to charge separately for professional engineering services or land surveying where other services or work are also being performed in connection with the engineering services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provisions of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a financial interest in bidding for or performance of a contract for a project for which employed as an engineer, without client disclosure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conflict of interest — Having a financial interest in bidding for or performance of a contract to supply labor or materials for or to construct a project for which employed or retained as an engineer except with the consent of the client or employer after disclosure of such facts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to promptly disclose to a client or employer any interest in a business that may compete with or affect the business of the client or employer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Nondisclosure — Failure to promptly disclose to a client or employer any interest in a business which may compete with or affect the business of the client or employer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Reducing a fee quoted for prospective employment as an engineer after being informed of another engineer's quoted fee for the same employment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unfair competition — Reducing a fee quoted for prospective employment or retainer as an engineer after being informed of the fee quoted by another engineer for the same employment or retainer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting employment by advertisement which is undignified, self-laudatory, false, or misleading, or which invites comparison between engineers.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improper advertising — Soliciting retainer or employment by advertisement which is undignified, self-laudatory, false or misleading, or which makes or invites comparison between the advertiser and other engineers

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any other act, or failing to act, that is customarily regarded as contrary to accepted professional conduct or standard generally expected of those practicing professional engineering or land surveying.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any other act, or failing to act, which act or failure are customarily regarded as being contrary to the accepted professional conduct or standard generally expected of those practicing professional engineering or land surveying.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the person's profession or operation of the person's business, whether the act constitutes a crime or not.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining, renewing, or reinstating a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining or renewing a license or in reinstatement thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is false, deceptive, or misleading.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising that is false, deceptive, or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice that results in harm or damage or creates an unreasonable risk of harm.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice that results in harm or damage to another or that creates an unreasonable risk of harm or damage to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation, or restriction of a license by competent authority in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The suspension, revocation, or restriction of a license to engage in any business or profession by competent authority in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate with the disciplinary authority in the course of an investigation, audit, or inspection.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate with the disciplinary authority in the course of an investigation, audit, or inspection authorized by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplinary authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplinary authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice a profession for which a license is required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice or operate a business or profession when a license is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of the profession beyond the scope of practice as defined by law or rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice or operation of a business or profession beyond the scope of practice or operation as defined by law or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation in any aspect of the conduct of the business or profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation in any aspect of the conduct of the business or profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately supervise or oversee auxiliary staff, whether employees or contractors, to the extent that consumers may be harmed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to adequately supervise or oversee auxiliary staff, whether employees or contractors, to the extent that consumers may be harmed or damaged

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the person's profession or operation of the person's business.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interference with an investigation or disciplinary action by willful misrepresentation, threats, harassment, or financial inducements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interference with an investigation or disciplinary action by willful misrepresentation of facts before the disciplinary authority or its authorized representatives, or by the use of threats or harassment against any consumer or witness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unlicensed practice as defined in RCW 18.235.010.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in unlicensed practice as defined in RCW 18.235.010.

definition_quote.value: 'Practice of engineering' means any professional service or creative work requiring engineering education, training, and experience and the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to such professional services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, and supervision of construction for the purpose of assuring compliance with specifications and design, in connection with any public or private utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, works, or projects.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of engineering" means any professional service or creative work requiring engineering education, training, and experience and the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to such professional services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, and supervision of construction for the purpose of assuring compliance with specifications and design, in connection with any public or private utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, works, or projects.

methods_authorized.quote: consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, and supervision of construction for the purpose of assuring compliance with specifications and design

covers_land_surveying.quote: A state board of registration for professional engineers and land surveyors is hereby created which shall exercise all of the powers and perform all of the duties conferred upon it by this chapter.

covers_geology.quote: The state geologist licensing board established in chapter 18.220 RCW.

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: The board shall issue to each applicant upon successfully passing the examination in fundamental engineering subjects a certificate stating that the applicant has passed the examination in fundamental engineering subjects and that his or her name has been recorded as an engineer-in-training.

surveyor_in_training_certificate_availab.quote: In case of land-surveyor-in-training, the certificate shall state that the applicant has successfully passed the examination in fundamental surveying subjects required by the board and has been enrolled as a "land-surveyor-in-training."

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: The board may, at its discretion, give credit as experience not in excess of one year, for satisfactory postgraduate study in engineering.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: shall designate a person holding a certificate of registration under this chapter as responsible for the practice of engineering by the corporation in this state and shall provide that full authority to make all final engineering decisions on behalf of the corporation with respect to work performed by the corporation in this state shall be granted and delegated by the board of directors to the person so designated in the resolution.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Plans, specifications, plats, and reports prepared by the registrant shall be signed, dated, and stamped with said seal or facsimile thereof.

seal_document_types.quote: Plans, specifications, plats, and reports prepared by the registrant shall be signed, dated, and stamped with said seal or facsimile thereof.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: The practice of engineering and/or land surveying in this state by a corporation or joint stock association: PROVIDED, That (a) The corporation has filed with the board an application for certificate of authorization

approximate.matched_normalized: in this state by a corporation or joint stock association provided that the corporation has filed with the board an application for certificate of authorization

value: Practice of any other legally recognized profession or trade

Nonresident not having established place of business in state, practicing no more than 30 days per calendar year, if legally qualified by registration in own state or country with equivalent requirements
Nonresident or recent resident who has filed an application for a certificate of registration and paid the required fee, while application is pending
Work of an employee or subordinate of a registered person, not including final design or decisions, done under direct responsibility and supervision of a registrant

Work of a person rendering engineering services to a corporation as an employee, when services are rendered in carrying on general business of the corporation not consisting of rendering engineering services to the general public, provided the corporation employs at least one registrant
Practice of officers or employees of the government of the United States while engaged within the state in the practice of engineering for the U.S. government
Nonresident engineers employed for the purpose of making engineering examinations
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This chapter shall not be construed to prevent or affect: (1) The practice of any other legally recognized profession or trade; or (2) The practice of a person not a resident and having no established place of business in this state, practicing or offering to practice herein the profession of engineering or land surveying, when such practice does not exceed in the aggregate more than thirty days in any calendar year

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: In addition to the unprofessional conduct described in RCW 18.235.130, the board may take disciplinary action for the following conduct, acts, or conditions

board_engineering_disciplines_represente.quote: Five members of the board shall be registered professional engineers licensed under the provisions of this chapter. Two members shall be registered professional land surveyors licensed under this chapter.

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: Each of the members of the board shall have been actively engaged in the practice of engineering or land surveying for at least ten years subsequent to registration, five of which shall have been immediately prior to their appointment to the board.

pdh_units_per_renewal_period.quote: the board may not renew a certificate of registration for a land surveyor unless the registrant verifies to the board that he or she has completed at least fifteen hours of continuing professional development per year of the registration period.

retired_status_license_available.quote: An individual certificated under this chapter who has reached the age of sixty-five years and has retired from the active practice of engineering and land surveying may, upon application and at the discretion of the board, be exempted from payment of annual renewal fees thereafter.
